rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Genève; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Genève; other communes in Geneva set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Genève; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier: note
rows.value: 147.5% of the base tax, less a 12% rebate on that cantonal tax (ESTV note 9)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Genève; other communes in Geneva set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).

rows.section: Corporate profit tax 2026 (Geneva)
rows.label: Profit tax rate (base rate)
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: AFC/ESTV Feuille cantonale Genève (Etat février 2026), personnes morales: calcul de l'impôt, Art. 20 LIPM

rows.section: Corporate profit tax 2026 (Geneva)
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier 2026 (profit tax)
rows.value: 188.5% (plus intercommunal equalisation of 43.5% on 20% of the simple tax)
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Geneva)
rows.label: Who levies it
rows.value: The canton only (no communal property tax)
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Geneva)
rows.label: Registration duty on transfers of real estate: normal rate
rows.note: ESTV, legislation as of 1 January 2022
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Handänderungssteuer (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2022, November 2022)

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Geneva)
rows.label: Main residence relief
rows.value: A fixed reduction of the duty for a buyer's main residence up to a value cap, indexed each year by regulation (2022 figures in the ESTV source: first CHF 18,877 not levied for homes up to CHF 1,258,454); the 2026 amounts were not read
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Handänderungssteuer (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2022, November 2022)
